name: Big Sun Shine Co. Ltd.
summary: Big Sun Shine Co. Ltd. serves as a provider of home textile products across Taiwan. The company offers a diverse range of fabrics, including jacquard, dobby, yarn-dyed, and piece-dyed materials. These textiles come with specialized properties such as fire retardancy, anti-microbial, anti-odor, anti-UV protection, and insulation, making them suitable for various household applications like draperies, upholstery, curtains, and tablecloths, as well as other general-purpose uses. Furthermore, Big Sun Shine is involved in the design and distribution of woven fabrics. Established in 1982, the firm adopted its current name in September 2020, having previously operated as Sumagh High Tech Corporation. Its headquarters are located in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.
